1.web: Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
1.asv: O Jehovah, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee.

2.web: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
2.asv: Let my prayer enter into thy presence; Incline thine ear unto my cry.

3.web: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
3.asv: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto Sheol.

4.web: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
4.asv: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit; I am as a man that hath no help,

5.web: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
5.asv: Cast off among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom thou rememberest no more, And they are cut off from thy hand.

6.web: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
6.asv: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in the deeps.

7.web: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.
7.asv: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. [Selah

8.web: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
8.asv: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

9.web: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.
9.asv: Mine eye wasteth away by reason of affliction: I have called daily upon thee, O Jehovah; I have spread forth my hands unto thee.

10.web: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.
10.asv: Wilt thou show wonders to the dead? Shall they that are deceased arise and praise thee? [Selah

11.web: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
11.asv: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or thy faithfulness in Destruction?

12.web: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
12.asv: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

13.web: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
13.asv: But unto thee, O Jehovah, have I cried; And in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.

14.web: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
14.asv: Jehovah, why castest thou off my soul? Why hidest thou thy face from me?

15.web: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
15.asv: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: While I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

16.web: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
16.asv: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.

17.web: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
17.asv: They came round about me like water all the day long; They compassed me about together.

18.web: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
18.asv: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.
